subject: Just onboarded Hudl
text:
Hey [NAME]​,

We've recently onboarded Hudl, helping them to move over from V7 as they look for a reliable partner to support their scaling ambitions.

Over the last year, we've onboarded several large teams from V7 (Abyss Solutions, Intenseye, Sentera) who all came to Encord frustrated by the lack of support from V7 as it continues its shift away from developing its annotation suite & pivots towards V7 Go. 

At Encord, we're continuing to double down on improvements to the annotation editor, data curation, and model evaluation suites - alongside significant investments in our customer success function to ensure we can build in partnership with our customers.

Open to having a catch-up?

subject: Coffee @ISC West [YEAR]?
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about Hanwha Vision's cloud portal - kudos to
your product leadership! Reaching out since we work w/ Milestone Systems,
Rhombus, LiveView Technologies, Flock Safety etc. on developing similar
computer vision models for video surveillance. I saw Hanwha is exhibiting
at ISC West [YEAR] - would be great  to connect if you're attending?

Bit of context on Encord: We're a computer vision data development platform
for leading physical security teams. We consolidate large-scale video data
curation, annotation and model evaluation -- with the goal of helping ML
teams in physical security enhance detection accuracy and accelerating
speed to market with new security products.

Would you be open to a coffee with our leadership @ISC West [YEAR]? Our US
Director will be there Wednesday (4/2) to Friday (4/4). If virtual is
easier, happy to find a time that suits you!

subject: [Invite] Physical AI Panel @ AWS Loft 04/15
text:
Hi [NAME],

Hope all's well! We're hosting an intimate Physical AI event with our
investors from Next47 on April 15th at the AWS Loft in SF (capping
attendance to 40), and we'd love for you to join if you're interested / can
make it!

It'll run from 5:30-8:30pm, kicking off with a panel discussion on Physical
AI - hearing perspectives on building, scaling, and investing in the space.
Panelists include Heads of AI from Skydio, Archetype AI, our Co-Founder
[SENDER], and moderated by Colton Dempsey, Partner @ Next47.

Following the panel, we've planned an informal networking session with
refreshments - bringing together technical leaders from Ambi Robotics, 1X,
Figure AI, Physical Intelligence, etc.

Bit of context on Encord…we're a computer vision scale-up (recently raised
a $30M Series B) focused on streamlining data curation, annotation,
workflow management, and model evaluation under one platform.

Should be a great evening - let me know if you're available & I'll reserve
you a spot / send over an invite.
